literature.headline_zh: SARS-CoV-2本期文献呈现多方向研究进展
literature.lead_zh: 本期重点文献按发表日期、相关性、证据等级和研究质量综合排序，研究结果与综述证据分别核验后形成以下进展。
key_findings_zh: 研究结果显示,在异源加强疫苗接种之前有较高的基线中和作用,并且在接受加强疫苗接种后 6 个月内,对 SARS-CoV2 的所有三种变体均具有持久的保护性中和作用。 [10.1093/infdis/jiag363]

测序鉴定了所有时间点的 GE.1 谱系。在检测后 23 周之前,检测到 ORF1ab(位置 8942-12458)发生宿主内重组事件,随后病毒载量增加 14 倍(7.42e+06 至 1.00e+08 RNA 拷贝/mL),并且病毒群体发生显着变化。E340D 是一种 sotrovimab 耐药突变,在感染后第一周内以低丰度 (46%) 检测到,随时间波动,并在检测后第 15 周(107 天)几乎固定。虽然所有突变都显示出 E340D 的添加增强了感染性,但这种效果在基线感染性较低的突变中最为明显。 [10.64898/2026.07.14.26356329]
在调整年龄、近期感染、暴露环境和时间趋势后,较高的抗体水平,尤其是核衣壳结合抗体和 Omicron 特异性中和抗体,与 SARS-CoV-2 感染风险降低显着相关(调整后的风险比范围为每 log10 倍抗体水平 (AU/mL) 阳性单位差异 0.60 至 0.87)。 [10.1038/s41467-026-74684-8]
生物物理分析证实颗粒呈圆形,尺寸约为 180-200 nm。研究发现,免疫小鼠的血清 IgG、IgM 和 IgA 水平高于未感染小鼠。 [10.1186/s12985-026-03256-5]
50%的病例出现全身皮疹,而局部皮疹主要影响四肢。 [10.1371/journal.pone.0352201]
literature.trend_or_risk_zh: 本期研究方向以入选文献实际覆盖的临床、流行病学、宿主生态、诊断或分子监测主题为准。
literature.caveats_zh: 部分证据来自摘要、观察性研究或叙述性综述，结论应结合研究设计和证据等级理解。
literature.headline_en: Recent Severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2 literature
literature.lead_en: This literature brief prioritizes publications in the active reporting window and ranks them by relevance, evidence availability, study quality, recency and source convergence.
key_findings_en: Findings showed high baseline neutralisation prior to heterologous booster vaccinations and enduring protective neutralisation against all three variants of SARS-CoV2 at 6 months following booster receipt. [10.1093/infdis/jiag363]

Sequencing identified the GE.1 lineage at all timepoints. An intra-host recombination event in ORF1ab (positions 8942-12458) was detected prior to 23 weeks post-detection, followed by a 14-fold increase in viral load (7.42e+06 to 1.00e+08 RNA copies/mL) and a marked shift in the viral population. [10.64898/2026.07.14.26356329]

Higher antibody levels, notably nucleocapsid-binding and Omicron-specific neutralizing antibodies, are significantly associated with reduced risk of SARS-CoV-2 infection after adjusting for age, recent infection, exposure settings, and temporal trends (adjusted hazard ratios ranging from 0.60 to 0.87 per positive unit difference in log10-fold antibody level (AU/mL)). [10.1038/s41467-026-74684-8]

The biophysical analysis confirms that the particles are round and have a size of ~ 180-200 nm. The serum levels of IgG, IgM, and IgA were found to be higher in immunized mice than in uninfected mice. [10.1186/s12985-026-03256-5]
Generalized rashes occurred in 50% of cases, while localized rashes mainly affected the extremities. [10.1371/journal.pone.0352201]
literature.trend_or_risk_en: The direction of this week's research is defined by the clinical, epidemiological, ecological, diagnostic and molecular topics actually represented by the eligible publications.
literature.caveats_en: Some evidence is abstract-only, observational or derived from narrative reviews; conclusions should be interpreted in light of study design and evidence strength.
literature.brief_en: This literature brief prioritizes papers published in the active reporting window and ranks them by relevance, evidence availability, study quality, recency, and independent-source convergence. Detailed study-specific evidence is retained in the article cards below.

papers.title: The Role of Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning in Predictive Virology: Forecasting, Tracking, and Combating Viral Threats.
papers.abstract: The escalating threat of viral pandemics, dramatically illustrated by the COVID-19 crisis, has exposed the critical shortcomings of conventional reactive virology in addressing rapidly evolving pathogens. This review introduces predictive virology (PV) as an artificial intelligence (AI)-driven discipline within broader epidemic intelligence and public health surveillance that uses advanced computational tools to forecast viral threats and accelerate countermeasure design. The current review systematically examines how AI-driven approaches ( e.g. , machine learning and deep learning) are reshaping virology by integrating vast genomic datasets, multimodal surveillance signals, and advanced computational models to anticipate viral emergence and evolution before widespread transmission occurs. Core pillars of PV discussed include zero-shot mutational fitness and antigenic escape prediction using large protein language models; multimodal early-warning systems that fuse wastewater monitoring, digital epidemiology, mobility data, and social media; neural differential equation-based transmission modeling; generative AI for de novo design of broad-spectrum antivirals and vaccines; and ecological risk assessment of zoonotic spillovers. In retrospective benchmarks against deep mutational scanning experiments and real-world epidemiological outcomes (SARS-CoV-2 variants, influenza, and other outbreaks), several AI-powered tools have demonstrated performance comparable to or exceeding traditional methods, although prospective validation at scale remains limited. Despite remarkable progress, significant challenges persist, including data bias, overfitting to historical patterns, lack of prospective validation, and limited generalizability across settings. In addition, there are concerns about mechanistic interpretability, equitable global data integration, and responsible deployment. This review also critically addresses the ethical, governance, and equity implications of deploying predictive capabilities at a global scale. By consolidating cutting-edge AI methodologies with virological insights and acknowledging current limitations, this work provides a comprehensive framework for transitioning virology from a reactive to a truly predictive discipline, ultimately strengthening global health security and pandemic preparedness.

analysis.scope_and_question: The review examines the role of artificial intelligence and machine learning in predictive virology, focusing on forecasting, tracking, and combating viral threats. It explores how AI-driven approaches reshape virology by integrating genomic datasets, surveillance signals, and computational models to anticipate viral emergence and evolution before widespread transmission occurs. The central question is how AI can transform virology from a reactive to a predictive discipline.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review systematically examines AI-driven approaches such as machine learning and deep learning. It integrates vast genomic datasets, multimodal surveillance signals, and advanced computational models. The review critically addresses ethical, governance, and equity implications of deploying predictive capabilities at a global scale.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: Several AI-powered tools have demonstrated performance comparable to or exceeding traditional methods in retrospective benchmarks against deep mutational scanning experiments and real-world epidemiological outcomes. Core pillars of predictive virology include zero-shot mutational fitness and antigenic escape prediction, multimodal early-warning systems, neural differential equation-based transmission modeling, generative AI for antiviral and vaccine design, and ecological risk assessment of zoonotic spillovers.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: Prospective validation at scale remains limited. Significant challenges persist, including data bias, overfitting to historical patterns, lack of prospective validation, and limited generalizability across settings. Concerns also exist about mechanistic interpretability, equitable global data integration, and responsible deployment.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: Priorities include developing robust prospective validation frameworks, addressing data bias and overfitting, improving mechanistic interpretability, ensuring equitable global data integration, and establishing responsible deployment protocols. The work provides a comprehensive framework for transitioning virology from a reactive to a predictive discipline, strengthening global health security and pandemic preparedness.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 该综述探讨了人工智能和机器学习在预测病毒学中的作用,重点关注预测、跟踪和对抗病毒威胁。它探讨了人工智能驱动的方法如何通过整合基因组数据集、监测信号和计算模型来重塑病毒学,以在广泛传播发生之前预测病毒的出现和进化。核心问题是人工智能如何将病毒学从反应性学科转变为预测性学科。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 该评论系统地研究了机器学习和深度学习等人工智能驱动的方法。它集成了大量的基因组数据集、多模式监测信号和先进的计算模型。该审查批判性地解决了在全球范围内部署预测能力的道德、治理和公平影响。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 在针对深度突变扫描实验和现实世界流行病学结果的回顾性基准测试中,多种人工智能工具的性能与传统方法相当或超过传统方法。预测病毒学的核心支柱包括零次突变适应度和抗原逃逸预测、多模式预警系统、基于神经微分方程的传播模型、用于抗病毒和疫苗设计的生成人工智能以及人畜共患病溢出的生态风险评估。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 大规模的前瞻性验证仍然有限。仍然存在重大挑战,包括数据偏差、过度拟合历史模式、缺乏前瞻性验证以及跨环境的普遍性有限。还存在对机械解释性、公平的全球数据集成和负责任的部署的担忧。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 优先事项包括开发强大的前瞻性验证框架、解决数据偏差和过度拟合、提高机械可解释性、确保公平的全球数据集成以及建立负责任的部署协议。这项工作为将病毒学从反应性学科转变为预测性学科、加强全球卫生安全和大流行病防范提供了一个全面的框架。

analysis_en.scope_and_question: The review examines the role of artificial intelligence and machine learning in predictive virology, focusing on forecasting, tracking, and combating viral threats. It explores how AI-driven approaches reshape virology by integrating genomic datasets, surveillance signals, and computational models to anticipate viral emergence and evolution before widespread transmission occurs. The central question is how AI can transform virology from a reactive to a predictive discipline.
analysis_en.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review systematically examines AI-driven approaches such as machine learning and deep learning. It integrates vast genomic datasets, multimodal surveillance signals, and advanced computational models. The review critically addresses ethical, governance, and equity implications of deploying predictive capabilities at a global scale.
analysis_en.consensus_and_key_conclusions: Several AI-powered tools have demonstrated performance comparable to or exceeding traditional methods in retrospective benchmarks against deep mutational scanning experiments and real-world epidemiological outcomes. Core pillars of predictive virology include zero-shot mutational fitness and antigenic escape prediction, multimodal early-warning systems, neural differential equation-based transmission modeling, generative AI for antiviral and vaccine design, and ecological risk assessment of zoonotic spillovers.
analysis_en.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: Prospective validation at scale remains limited. papers.title_zh: 人工智能和机器学习在预测病毒学中的作用:预测、跟踪和对抗病毒威胁。
papers.source_body_en: The escalating threat of viral pandemics, dramatically illustrated by the COVID-19 crisis, has exposed the critical shortcomings of conventional reactive virology in addressing rapidly evolving pathogens. This review introduces predictive virology (PV) as an artificial intelligence (AI)-driven discipline within broader epidemic intelligence and public health surveillance that uses advanced computational tools to forecast viral threats and accelerate countermeasure design. The current review systematically examines how AI-driven approaches ( e.g. , machine learning and deep learning) are reshaping virology by integrating vast genomic datasets, multimodal surveillance signals, and advanced computational models to anticipate viral emergence and evolution before widespread transmission occurs. Core pillars of PV discussed include zero-shot mutational fitness and antigenic escape prediction using large protein language models; multimodal early-warning systems that fuse wastewater monitoring, digital epidemiology, mobility data, and social media; neural differential equation-based transmission modeling; generative AI for de novo design of broad-spectrum antivirals and vaccines; and ecological risk assessment of zoonotic spillovers. In retrospective benchmarks against deep mutational scanning experiments and real-world epidemiological outcomes (SARS-CoV-2 variants, influenza, and other outbreaks), several AI-powered tools have demonstrated performance comparable to or exceeding traditional methods, although prospective validation at scale remains limited. Despite remarkable progress, significant challenges persist, including data bias, overfitting to historical patterns, lack of prospective validation, and limited generalizability across settings. In addition, there are concerns about mechanistic interpretability, equitable global data integration, and responsible deployment. This review also critically addresses the ethical, governance, and equity implications of deploying predictive capabilities at a global scale. By consolidating cutting-edge AI methodologies with virological insights and acknowledging current limitations, this work provides a comprehensive framework for transitioning virology from a reactive to a truly predictive discipline, ultimately strengthening global health security and pandemic preparedness.
papers.abstract_zh: COVID-19 危机充分说明了病毒大流行的威胁不断升级,暴露了传统反应性病毒学在应对快速演变的病原体方面的严重缺陷。本综述介绍了预测病毒学(PV)作为更广泛的流行病情报和公共卫生监测中人工智能(AI)驱动的学科,它使用先进的计算工具来预测病毒威胁并加速对策设计。当前的综述系统地研究了人工智能驱动的方法(例如机器学习和深度学习)如何通过整合大量基因组数据集、多模式监测信号和先进的计算模型来重塑病毒学,以在广泛传播发生之前预测病毒的出现和进化。讨论的 PV 核心支柱包括使用大型蛋白质语言模型的零次突变适应度和抗原逃逸预测;融合废水监测、数字流行病学、移动数据和社交媒体的多模式预警系统;基于神经微分方程的传输建模;用于广谱抗病毒药物和疫苗从头设计的生成式人工智能;人畜共患病溢出效应的生态风险评估。在针对深度突变扫描实验和现实世界流行病学结果(SARS-CoV-2变种、流感和其他疫情)的回顾性基准中,一些人工智能驱动的工具已证明其性能可与或超过传统方法,尽管大规模的前瞻性验证仍然有限。尽管取得了显着的进展,但仍然存在重大挑战,包括数据偏差、过度拟合历史模式、缺乏前瞻性验证以及跨环境的普遍性有限。此外,人们还担心机械可解释性、公平的全球数据集成和负责任的部署。本次审查还批判性地讨论了在全球范围内部署预测能力的道德、治理和公平影响。通过将尖端人工智能方法与病毒学见解相结合,并承认当前的局限性,这项工作提供了一个全面的框架,将病毒学从反应性学科转变为真正的预测性学科,最终加强全球卫生安全和大流行病防范。

papers.title: Variant-specific and cross-reactive antibody responses following COVID-19 booster vaccinations and SARS-CoV-2 breakthrough infections
papers.abstract: Abstract SARS-CoV-2 has evolved into several genetic variants, all bearing mutations that reduce antibody binding and affect vaccine and treatment effectiveness. Updated COVID-19 vaccines, including bivalent formulations (wild type [WT]/BA.1 or WT/BA.5) and more recent monovalent versions targeting emerging variants such as XBB.1.5, JN.1, KP.2 or LP.8.1, were developed to broaden protection. However, immune imprinting may limit the induction of neutralizing antibodies against strains that differ significantly, even after receiving several variant-specific boosters. A deeper understanding of how booster vaccination reshapes antibody specificity remains essential for rational vaccine design. We examined the antibody response to a bivalent WT/BA.5 booster, focusing on antibody levels and neutralization. Serum samples collected before and after a fourth dose of monovalent WT or bivalent (WT/BA.5) mRNA vaccines were compared with sera from individuals after primary WT infections and Omicron BA.1, BA.2, or BA.5 breakthrough infections. We found that both monovalent and bivalent boosters significantly increased IgG and neutralizing antibodies, but breakthrough infections induced broader cross-reactive responses. Depletion experiments revealed that booster-induced immunity was predominantly mediated by cross-reactive antibodies, with the highest levels after breakthrough infections and the lowest after a primary WT infection. These findings provide functional insights into the antibody specificities associated with imprinting effects following variant-adapted booster vaccination.

Updated COVID-19 vaccines, including bivalent formulations (wild type [WT]/BA.1 or WT/BA.5) and more recent monovalent versions targeting emerging variants such as XBB.1.5, JN.1, KP.2 or LP.8.1, were developed to broaden protection. However, immune imprinting may limit the induction of neutralizing antibodies against strains that differ significantly, even after receiving several variant-specific boosters. A deeper understanding of how booster vaccination reshapes antibody specificity remains essential for rational vaccine design. We examined the antibody response to a bivalent WT/BA.5 booster, focusing on antibody levels and neutralization. Serum samples collected before and after a fourth dose of monovalent WT or bivalent (WT/BA.5) mRNA vaccines were compared with sera from individuals after primary WT infections and Omicron BA.1, BA.2, or BA.5 breakthrough infections. We found that both monovalent and bivalent boosters significantly increased IgG and neutralizing antibodies, but breakthrough infections induced broader cross-reactive responses. Depletion experiments revealed that booster-induced immunity was predominantly mediated by cross-reactive antibodies, with the highest levels after breakthrough infections and the lowest after a primary WT infection. These findings provide functional insights into the antibody specificities associated with imprinting effects following variant-adapted booster vaccination.

papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 SARS-CoV-2 已进化成多种基因变体,所有变体都带有降低抗体结合并影响疫苗和治疗效果的突变。更新的 COVID-19 疫苗,包括二价制剂(野生型 [WT]/BA.1 或 WT/BA.5)和针对 XBB.1.5、JN.1、KP.2 或 LP.8.1 等新兴变种的最新单价版本,旨在扩大保护范围。然而,免疫印记可能会限制针对显着差异菌株的中和抗体的诱导,即使在接受了几种变体特异性加强剂后也是如此。更深入地了解加强疫苗接种如何重塑抗体特异性对于合理的疫苗设计仍然至关重要。我们检查了抗体对二价 WT/BA.5 加强剂的反应,重点关注抗体水平和中和。将第四剂单价 WT 或二价 (WT/BA.5) mRNA 疫苗前后收集的血清样本与原发 WT 感染和 Omicron BA.1、BA.2 或 BA.5 突破性感染后个体的血清进行比较。我们发现单价和二价加强剂均显着增加了 IgG 和中和抗体,但突破性感染引发了更广泛的交叉反应。耗竭实验表明,加强诱导的免疫主要由交叉反应抗体介导,突破性感染后水平最高,初次 WT 感染后水平最低。这些发现为与变异适应加强疫苗接种后的印记效应相关的抗体特异性提供了功能性见解。

papers.title: Cost and Safety Perceptions as Determinants of COVID-19 Vaccination Intention in Saudi Arabia
papers.abstract: Background: Public acceptance of vaccines during emerging infectious disease outbreaks is influenced by perceptions of safety, accessibility, and cost. Understanding these determinants during the early phase of a pandemic is important for informing vaccination policy and communication strategies. This study examined the role of vaccine cost and safety perceptions in shaping COVID-19 vaccination intention among adults in Saudi Arabia prior to national vaccine rollout. Methods: A cross-sectional electronic survey was conducted among adults residing in Saudi Arabia between August and September 2020. Participants were recruited through online distribution using social media and electronic communication channels. The questionnaire assessed socio-demographic characteristics, knowledge and perceptions regarding COVID-19, and intention to receive COVID-19 vaccination under five hypothetical scenarios reflecting vaccine cost and the availability of scientific safety and efficacy evidence. Multivariable logistic regression analyses were performed to identify factors associated with vaccination intention. Results: A total of 1293 respondents completed the survey. When vaccination was offered free of charge, 57.5% of participants reported that they would likely receive the vaccine. Vaccination intention declined as the hypothetical vaccine price increased, reaching 38.7% when the cost exceeded 100 SAR. Intention was lowest when vaccination was presented under conditions in which safety and efficacy evidence had not yet been confirmed. Age, gender, educational attainment, and prior seasonal influenza vaccination were associated with COVID-19 vaccination intention across several scenarios. Conclusions: Perceived vaccine affordability and confidence in scientific safety and efficacy evidence were important factors associated with COVID-19 vaccination intention during the early phase of the pandemic in Saudi Arabia. Providing vaccination without direct cost to recipients and communicating safety and efficacy evidence transparently may support public confidence and vaccine acceptance during future large-scale immunization campaigns. These findings should be interpreted as an early-pandemic baseline and should not be extrapolated to current post-rollout attitudes.

papers.title_zh: 成本和安全认知是沙特阿拉伯 COVID-19 疫苗接种意愿的决定因素
papers.source_body_en: Background: Public acceptance of vaccines during emerging infectious disease outbreaks is influenced by perceptions of safety, accessibility, and cost. Understanding these determinants during the early phase of a pandemic is important for informing vaccination policy and communication strategies. This study examined the role of vaccine cost and safety perceptions in shaping COVID-19 vaccination intention among adults in Saudi Arabia prior to national vaccine rollout. Methods: A cross-sectional electronic survey was conducted among adults residing in Saudi Arabia between August and September 2020. Participants were recruited through online distribution using social media and electronic communication channels. The questionnaire assessed socio-demographic characteristics, knowledge and perceptions regarding COVID-19, and intention to receive COVID-19 vaccination under five hypothetical scenarios reflecting vaccine cost and the availability of scientific safety and efficacy evidence. Multivariable logistic regression analyses were performed to identify factors associated with vaccination intention. Results: A total of 1293 respondents completed the survey. When vaccination was offered free of charge, 57.5% of participants reported that they would likely receive the vaccine. Vaccination intention declined as the hypothetical vaccine price increased, reaching 38.7% when the cost exceeded 100 SAR. Intention was lowest when vaccination was presented under conditions in which safety and efficacy evidence had not yet been confirmed. Age, gender, educational attainment, and prior seasonal influenza vaccination were associated with COVID-19 vaccination intention across several scenarios. Conclusions: Perceived vaccine affordability and confidence in scientific safety and efficacy evidence were important factors associated with COVID-19 vaccination intention during the early phase of the pandemic in Saudi Arabia. Providing vaccination without direct cost to recipients and communicating safety and efficacy evidence transparently may support public confidence and vaccine acceptance during future large-scale immunization campaigns. These findings should be interpreted as an early-pandemic baseline and should not be extrapolated to current post-rollout attitudes.
papers.abstract_zh: 背景:新发传染病爆发期间公众对疫苗的接受程度受到对安全性、可及性和成本的看法的影响。在大流行的早期阶段了解这些决定因素对于制定疫苗接种政策和沟通策略非常重要。本研究探讨了在全国疫苗推出之前,疫苗成本和安全性认知在沙特阿拉伯成年人中塑造 COVID-19 疫苗接种意愿方面的作用。方法:对 2020 年 8 月至 9 月期间居住在沙特阿拉伯的成年人进行了一项横断面电子调查。参与者是通过社交媒体和电子通信渠道在线分发招募的。该调查问卷评估了有关 COVID-19 的社会人口特征、知识和看法,以及在反映疫苗成本以及科学安全性和有效性证据的可用性的五种假设情景下接受 COVID-19 疫苗接种的意愿。进行多变量逻辑回归分析以确定与疫苗接种意愿相关的因素。结果:共有 1293 名受访者完成了调查。当免费提供疫苗接种时,57.5% 的参与者表示他们可能会接种疫苗。随着假设疫苗价格的上涨,疫苗接种意愿下降,当成本超过 100 SAR 时,疫苗接种意愿下降至 38.7%。当在安全性和有效性证据尚未得到证实的情况下接种疫苗时,意愿最低。在多种情况下,年龄、性别、教育程度和之前接种季节性流感疫苗与 COVID-19 疫苗接种意愿相关。结论:在沙特阿拉伯大流行的早期阶段,疫苗的可负担性以及对科学安全性和有效性证据的信心是与 COVID-19 疫苗接种意愿相关的重要因素。在不向接受者产生直接费用的情况下提供疫苗接种,并透明地传达安全性和有效性证据,可能会在未来大规模免疫运动中支持公众信心和疫苗接受度。这些发现应被解释为大流行早期的基线,不应推断为当前推出后的态度。

papers.title: Dynamic-Parameter SIRD Forecasting: ReproducibleTime-Varying Rate Estimation for COVID-19
papers.abstract: Abstract Classical compartmental epidemic models typically assume constant transmission, recovery, and mortality rates, limiting their ability to track policy shifts, behavioral adaptation,and multi-wave outbreaks. We present a hybrid SIRD framework that recovers time-varyingtransition parameters (α(t), β(t), γ(t)) by direct algebraic inversion of surveillance series,models their joint evolution with Vector Autoregression, and integrates the mechanistic system forward. In a 12-step held-out benchmark on a single global COVID-19 aggregate series(2020–2026), evaluated on daily incident counts, the open-source dynasir implementationachieved 39.3% MAPE for new cases and 29.7% for new deaths, outperforming naive persistence (100% for both), static SIRD (116.0% and 172.2%), and ARIMA incidence (631.7%and 79.6%). These correspond to 60.7% and 62.7% reductions relative to the strongest nondynamic reference for each outcome. The estimator maintains O(N) complexity and preserves interpretable R0(t) trajectories. However, nominal 95% prediction intervals achievedonly 33.3% coverage for cases and 41.7% for deaths. The framework is therefore best interpreted as a reproducible point-forecasting baseline for this benchmark pending improvedprobabilistic calibration and broader multi-region or cross-pathogen validation.

papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 经典的区室流行病模型通常假设传播、恢复和死亡率恒定,限制了它们跟踪政策转变、行为适应和多波疫情的能力。我们提出了一种混合 SIRD 框架,该框架通过监视序列的直接代数反演来恢复时变转移参数(α(t),β(t),γ(t)),用向量自回归对其联合演化进行建模,并向前集成机械系统。在针对单个全球 COVID-19 聚合系列(2020-2026)的 12 步坚持基准中,根据每日事件计数进行评估,开源 dynasir 实现的新病例 MAPE 为 39.3%,新死亡病例为 29.7%,优于幼稚持久性(两者均为 100%)、静态 SIRD(116.0% 和 172.2%)以及 ARIMA 发生率(631.7%和79.6%)。相对于每个结果的最强非动态参考,这对应于 60.7% 和 62.7% 的减少。估计器保持 O(N) 复杂度并保留可解释的 R0(t) 轨迹。然而,名义上的 95% 预测区间仅实现了 33.3% 的病例覆盖率和 41.7% 的死亡覆盖率。因此,该框架最好被解释为该基准的可重复点预测基线,等待改进的概率校准和更广泛的多区域或跨病原体验证。

papers.title: Proteomic analysis identifies pathways related to immune dysregulation in patients with hematologic malignancies after COVID-19 infection
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Patients with hematologic malignancies (HMs) are particularly vulnerable to coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19) because of underlying immune dysfunction and treatment-related immunosuppression. However, proteomic features associated with different clinical trajectories in this population remain insufficiently characterized. We performed serum proteomic analysis in 40 HM patients with COVID-19 and 15 healthy controls. Compared with controls, HM patients showed impaired immune-related responses during the acute phase of COVID-19. Acute-phase proteomic patterns differed across outcome groups; however, because outcome groups were closely intertwined with initial COVID-19 severity, ICU admission, and systemic illness, and because multivariable adjustment was not performed due to the limited sample size, these patterns should be interpreted as severity- and outcome-associated profiles rather than independent trajectory-specific markers. Fatal cases showed evidence of dysregulated immune activation, whereas patients later classified as having long COVID exhibited broader suppression of immune-related pathways. In addition to immune alterations, pathways related to platelet activation and cardiac-related dysfunction were associated with adverse clinical trajectories. analysis.scope_and_question: The study investigates serum proteomic features in patients with hematologic malignancies (HMs) who contracted COVID-19, aiming to characterize immune dysregulation and identify pathways associated with different clinical trajectories.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The study is a proteomic analysis involving 40 HM patients with COVID-19 and 15 healthy controls, with findings supported by enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay validation.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates serum proteomic features in hematologic malignancy (HM) patients with COVID-19 to characterize immune dysregulation and identify pathways linked to clinical outcomes. The analysis of 40 HM patients and 15 healthy controls revealed impaired immune responses during the acute phase, with fatal cases showing dysregulated immune activation and long COVID patients exhibiting broader immune suppression. Additionally, pathways related to platelet activation and cardiac dysfunction were associated with adverse trajectories. The authors emphasize that these patterns reflect severity and outcome associations rather than independent markers, due to limited sample size. The findings provide a foundation for future mechanistic studies, biomarker development, and risk stratification in this high-risk population.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 该研究调查了感染 COVID-19 的血液恶性肿瘤 (HM) 患者的血清蛋白质组学特征,旨在表征免疫失调并确定与不同临床轨迹相关的途径。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 该研究是一项蛋白质组学分析,涉及 40 名患有 COVID-19 的 HM 患者和 15 名健康对照者,其结果得到了酶联免疫吸附测定验证的支持。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 与对照组相比,HM 患者在 COVID-19 急性期表现出免疫相关反应受损。致命病例显示出免疫激活失调的证据,而长期感染的新冠患者则表现出更广泛的免疫相关途径抑制。血小板激活和心脏相关功能障碍途径与不良临床轨迹相关。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 该研究承认,不同结果组的急性期蛋白质组学模式有所不同,但与最初的 COVID-19 严重程度、入住 ICU 和全身性疾病密切相关。由于样本量有限,未进行多变量调整,并且模式应解释为与严重性和结果相关的概况,而不是独立的轨迹特异性标记。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 这些发现提供了 HM 患者中 COVID-19 的蛋白质组学概述,并为未来的机制研究和更大规模的外部验证队列提供了基础。它们支持未来针对这一高风险人群的生物标志物开发、风险分层和有针对性的临床管理。

papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 由于潜在的免疫功能障碍和治疗相关的免疫抑制,血液恶性肿瘤 (HMs) 患者特别容易感染 2019 年冠状病毒病 (COVID-19)。然而,与该人群不同临床轨迹相关的蛋白质组学特征仍未得到充分表征。我们对 40 名患有 COVID-19 的 HM 患者和 15 名健康对照者进行了血清蛋白质组分析。与对照组相比,HM 患者在 COVID-19 急性期表现出免疫相关反应受损。不同结果组的急性期蛋白质组模式有所不同;然而,由于结果组与最初的COVID-19严重程度、ICU入院和全身性疾病密切相关,并且由于样本量有限而未进行多变量调整,因此这些模式应被解释为与严重程度和结果相关的概况,而不是独立的轨迹特异性标记。致命病例显示出免疫激活失调的证据,而后来被分类为长期感染新冠病毒的患者则表现出更广泛的免疫相关途径抑制。除了免疫改变之外,与血小板活化和心脏相关功能障碍相关的途径也与不良临床轨迹相关。酶联免疫吸附测定验证支持所选蛋白质与急性感染期间结果组的关联。这些发现提供了 HM 患者中 COVID-19 的蛋白质组学概述,并为未来的机制研究和更大规模的外部验证队列提供了基础。重要性 由于先前存在的免疫功能障碍,血液系统恶性肿瘤患者极易感染严重的 2019 冠状病毒病 (COVID-19)、急性死亡和长期感染新冠病毒。然而,与不良临床轨迹相关的蛋白质组学特征仍然知之甚少。我们的血清蛋白质组学研究确定了与不同结果相关的不同急性期免疫特征:广泛的免疫抑制是长期新冠肺炎的特征,而免疫激活失调则与致命病例相关。血小板活化和心脏相关通路也与不良结果有关。这些发现为这一高危人群提供了关键的分子见解,支持未来生物标志物的开发、风险分层和有针对性的临床管理。临床试验 本研究在 ClinicalTrials.gov 注册为 NCT05683353。该研究在 ClinicalTrials.gov 注册为 NCT05683353。

papers.title: Menstrual Cycle Changes among Reproduction-Aged Iranian Women Following COVID-19 Vaccination
papers.abstract: Background: Menstrual cycle disturbances have been increasingly reported after COVID-19 vaccination, raising questions about their prevalence and clinical significance among women of reproductive age. Objective This study aimed to investigate the incidence and types of menstrual cycle alterations following different doses of COVID-19 vaccines among Iranian women of reproductive age. Methods A cross-sectional survey was conducted among vaccinated women who reported their menstrual cycle status before and after each vaccine dose. Data on cycle regularity, flow characteristics, and specific menstrual disorders were collected and analyzed. Results Menstrual cycle alterations were reported by 28.8%, 25.4%, 30.3%, and 68.4% of participants after the first, second, third, and fourth vaccine doses, respectively. The most common changes were oligomenorrhea after the first and second doses (8.9% and 5.6%), menorrhagia after the third dose (5.3%), and hypomenorrhea after the fourth dose (8.3%). Comparisons with international studies revealed a wide variation in prevalence (ranging from 25% to 78%), which may be explained by differences in methodology, population characteristics, vaccine types, and pre-vaccination health status. Conclusion A considerable proportion of Iranian women experienced menstrual alterations following COVID-19 vaccination, most commonly oligomenorrhea, menorrhagia, and hypomenorrhea. While generally self-limiting, these findings highlight the need to integrate menstrual health into post-vaccination monitoring and patient counseling. Future research should explore the underlying immune–endocrine mechanisms and long-term clinical implications of these changes.

papers.abstract_zh: 背景:接种 COVID-19 疫苗后越来越多地报道月经周期紊乱,这引发了人们对其在育龄妇女中的患病率和临床意义的疑问。目的 本研究旨在调查伊朗育龄妇女接种不同剂量的 COVID-19 疫苗后月经周期改变的发生率和类型。方法 对已接种疫苗的女性进行横断面调查,报告每次疫苗接种前后的月经周期状况。收集并分析有关周期规律、血流特征和特定月经失调的数据。结果 在接种第一剂、第二剂、第三剂和第四剂疫苗后,分别有 28.8%、25.4%、30.3% 和 68.4% 的参与者报告月经周期发生变化。最常见的变化是第一剂和第二剂后月经稀发(8.9%和5.6%)、第三剂后月经过多(5.3%)和第四剂后月经量少(8.3%)。与国际研究的比较显示,患病率存在​​很大差异(从 25% 到 78%),这可能是由于方法、人群特征、疫苗类型和接种前健康状况的差异所致。结论 相当比例的伊朗女性在接种 COVID-19 疫苗后出现月经改变,最常见的是月经稀发、月经过多和月经量少。虽然这些发现通常具有自我限制性,但强调需要将月经健康纳入疫苗接种后监测和患者咨询中。未来的研究应该探索潜在的免疫内分泌机制以及这些变化的长期临床影响。

papers.title: Understanding Mental Health in Crisis: Key Determinants of Psychological Distress in Belgium during the first weeks of COVID-19 Lockdown
papers.abstract: Aims: : The COVID-19 pandemic has significantly impacted global mental health. At the onset of the pandemic (2020), Belgians experienced increased anxiety, depression, and psychological distress compared to 2018 due to the outbreak and the associated public health measures. Understanding the drivers of this distress is crucial for mitigating mental health effects in future crises. This study examines determinants of psychological distress in Belgium during the March 2020 lockdown, using data from the Great Corona Study (GCS). Methods: Data were drawn from the second wave of the GCS, a citizen science initiative conducted in Belgium on March 24, 2020, with 332,169 respondents. Psychological distress was measured using the General Health Questionnaire-12 (GHQ-12), applying a 2/3 cutoff to classify distress levels. To identify predictor variables, a random forest algorithm and literature review reduced 207 initial variables to 16. A generalized linear model was then used to examine associations between predictors and psychological distress Results: Psychological distress was significantly associated with various demographic, social, occupational, and health-related factors. Younger individuals, women, and residents of Wallonia or Brussels exhibited higher odds of distress. Household composition, and the frequency of real-life social interactions significantly influenced distress levels. Occupational status played a key role, with part-time employees and working students exhibiting higher levels of distress. At the same time retired individuals with no current occupation showed lower odds. Perceived workplace safety and compliance with public health measures also significantly impacted distress levels. Lastly, individuals experiencing influenza-like or COVID-19 symptoms had substantially higher odds of psychological distress. Conclusions: Our findings highlight significant sociodemographic, occupational, and health-related predictors of psychological distress during the initial COVID-19 lockdown in Belgium. Young adults, women, individuals with limited in-person interactions, and those experiencing influenza-like illness or COVID-19 symptoms were particularly vulnerable. Additionally, perceptions of others' adherence to preventive measures played a crucial role in mental well-being. These results highlight the complex interplay between individual and environmental factors in shaping psychological distress, providing valuable insights for future public health policies and mental health interventions during crises.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The COVID-19 pandemic imposed unprecedented public health measures that were associated with increased psychological distress, yet the specific determinants of this distress remained insufficiently understood in Belgium during the initial lockdown. The study aimed to identify key drivers of psychological distress to inform future mental health interventions in crisis settings.
analysis.study_design_and_population: A cross-sectional analysis was conducted using data from the Great Corona Study (GCS), a citizen science initiative in Belgium that collected responses on March 24, 2020, from 332,169 participants. The study focused on sociodemographic, occupational, social interaction, and health-related factors influencing psychological distress during the March 2020 lockdown.
analysis.methods: Psychological distress was measured using the General Health Questionnaire-12 (GHQ-12) with a 2/3 cutoff to classify distress levels. A random forest algorithm and literature review reduced 207 initial variables to 16 predictor variables, which were then analyzed using a generalized linear model to examine associations with psychological distress.
analysis.main_results: Psychological distress was significantly associated with younger age, female gender, residence in Wallonia or Brussels, household composition, lower frequency of real-life social interactions, part-time employment or student status, lack of current occupation, perceived workplace safety, compliance with public health measures, and experiencing influenza-like or COVID-19 symptoms.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret these findings as evidence that psychological distress during the lockdown was shaped by a complex interplay of individual vulnerabilities and environmental factors, highlighting particularly vulnerable groups such as young adults, women, and those with limited social interactions or symptoms. The novelty lies in the large-scale citizen science approach and the identification of perceived adherence to preventive measures as a determinant of mental well-being.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These results can inform targeted mental health interventions and public health policies by identifying high-risk groups and modifiable factors such as social interaction frequency and workplace safety perceptions during future crises.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The cross-sectional design limits causal inference, and the reliance on self-reported data may introduce bias. Despite the large sample size, the generalizability to other contexts or populations remains uncertain, warranting cautious interpretation of the findings.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated determinants of psychological distress in Belgium during the first weeks of the COVID-19 lockdown using data from the Great Corona Study (GCS), which collected responses from 332,169 participants on March 24, 2020. Psychological distress was measured using the GHQ-12 with a 2/3 cutoff, and associations were analyzed using a generalized linear model after reducing 207 variables to 16 predictors via random forest and literature review. Key findings showed higher odds of distress among younger individuals, women, residents of Wallonia or Brussels, those with limited in-person social interactions, part-time employees or students, and individuals experiencing influenza-like or COVID-19 symptoms. Lower distress was observed among retired individuals. Perceived workplace safety and compliance with public health measures also significantly impacted distress levels. The authors highlight the complex interplay between individual and environmental factors, particularly emphasizing the role of perceived adherence to preventive measures. These results provide actionable insights for designing targeted mental health interventions and public health policies during future crises.

analysis_en.research_question_and_background: The COVID-19 pandemic imposed unprecedented public health measures that were associated with increased psychological distress, yet the specific determinants of this distress remained insufficiently understood in Belgium during the initial lockdown. The study aimed to identify key drivers of psychological distress to inform future mental health interventions in crisis settings.
analysis_en.study_design_and_population: A cross-sectional analysis was conducted using data from the Great Corona Study (GCS), a citizen science initiative in Belgium that collected responses on March 24, 2020, from 332,169 participants. The study focused on sociodemographic, occupational, social interaction, and health-related factors influencing psychological distress during the March 2020 lockdown.
analysis_en.methods: Psychological distress was measured using the General Health Questionnaire-12 (GHQ-12) with a 2/3 cutoff to classify distress levels. A random forest algorithm and literature review reduced 207 initial variables to 16 predictor variables, which were then analyzed using a generalized linear model to examine associations with psychological distress.
analysis_en.main_results: Psychological distress was significantly associated with younger age, female gender, residence in Wallonia or Brussels, household composition, lower frequency of real-life social interactions, part-time employment or student status, lack of current occupation, perceived workplace safety, compliance with public health measures, and experiencing influenza-like or COVID-19 symptoms.
analysis_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret these findings as evidence that psychological distress during the lockdown was shaped by a complex interplay of individual vulnerabilities and environmental factors, highlighting particularly vulnerable groups such as young adults, women, and those with limited social interactions or symptoms. The novelty lies in the large-scale citizen science approach and the identification of perceived adherence to preventive measures as a determinant of mental well-being.
analysis_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These results can inform targeted mental health interventions and public health policies by identifying high-risk groups and modifiable factors such as social interaction frequency and workplace safety perceptions during future crises.
analysis_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The cross-sectional design limits causal inference, and the reliance on self-reported data may introduce bias. Despite the large sample size, the generalizability to other contexts or populations remains uncertain, warranting cautious interpretation of the findings.

papers.title_zh: 了解危机中的心理健康:COVID-19 封锁第一周期间比利时心理困扰的关键决定因素
papers.source_body_en: Aims: : The COVID-19 pandemic has significantly impacted global mental health. At the onset of the pandemic (2020), Belgians experienced increased anxiety, depression, and psychological distress compared to 2018 due to the outbreak and the associated public health measures. Understanding the drivers of this distress is crucial for mitigating mental health effects in future crises. This study examines determinants of psychological distress in Belgium during the March 2020 lockdown, using data from the Great Corona Study (GCS). Methods: Data were drawn from the second wave of the GCS, a citizen science initiative conducted in Belgium on March 24, 2020, with 332,169 respondents. Psychological distress was measured using the General Health Questionnaire-12 (GHQ-12), applying a 2/3 cutoff to classify distress levels. To identify predictor variables, a random forest algorithm and literature review reduced 207 initial variables to 16. A generalized linear model was then used to examine associations between predictors and psychological distress Results: Psychological distress was significantly associated with various demographic, social, occupational, and health-related factors. Younger individuals, women, and residents of Wallonia or Brussels exhibited higher odds of distress. Household composition, and the frequency of real-life social interactions significantly influenced distress levels. Occupational status played a key role, with part-time employees and working students exhibiting higher levels of distress. At the same time retired individuals with no current occupation showed lower odds. Perceived workplace safety and compliance with public health measures also significantly impacted distress levels. Lastly, individuals experiencing influenza-like or COVID-19 symptoms had substantially higher odds of psychological distress. Conclusions: Our findings highlight significant sociodemographic, occupational, and health-related predictors of psychological distress during the initial COVID-19 lockdown in Belgium. Young adults, women, individuals with limited in-person interactions, and those experiencing influenza-like illness or COVID-19 symptoms were particularly vulnerable. Additionally, perceptions of others' adherence to preventive measures played a crucial role in mental well-being. These results highlight the complex interplay between individual and environmental factors in shaping psychological distress, providing valuable insights for future public health policies and mental health interventions during crises.
papers.abstract_zh: 目标::COVID-19 大流行严重影响了全球心理健康。在大流行爆发时(2020 年),由于疫情爆发和相关的公共卫生措施,与 2018 年相比,比利时人的焦虑、抑郁和心理困扰有所增加。了解这种痛苦的驱动因素对于减轻未来危机中的心理健康影响至关重要。本研究利用大新冠研究 (GCS) 的数据,探讨了 2020 年 3 月封锁期间比利时心理困扰的决定因素。方法:数据来自第二波 GCS,这是一项于 2020 年 3 月 24 日在比利时开展的公民科学倡议,共有 332,169 名受访者。使用一般健康问卷 12 (GHQ-12) 测量心理困扰,并应用 2/3 截止值对困扰级别进行分类。为了确定预测变量,随机森林算法和文献综述将 207 个初始变量减少到 16 个。然后使用广义线性模型来检查预测变量和心理困扰之间的关联。结果:心理困扰与各种人口、社会、职业和健康相关因素显着相关。瓦隆或布鲁塞尔的年轻人、女性和居民表现出更高的痛苦几率。家庭组成和现实生活中社交互动的频率显着影响痛苦程度。职业地位发挥了关键作用,兼职员工和在职学生表现出更高程度的痛苦。与此同时,目前没有职业的退休人员的赔率较低。对工作场所安全的感知和对公共卫生措施的遵守也显着影响了痛苦程度。最后,出现流感样症状或 COVID-19 症状的人出现心理困扰的几率要高得多。结论:我们的研究结果强调了比利时 COVID-19 最初封锁期间心理困扰的重要社会人口、职业和健康相关预测因素。年轻人、女性、面对面互动有限的个人以及患有流感样疾病或 COVID-19 症状的人尤其容易受到影响。此外,对其他人遵守预防措施的看法对心理健康也起着至关重要的作用。这些结果凸显了个人和环境因素在形成心理困扰方面的复杂相互作用,为未来的公共卫生政策和危机期间的心理健康干预措施提供了宝贵的见解。

papers.title: Systematic review of amino acid profiles among COVID-19 patients caused by SARS-CoV-2
papers.abstract: Abstract Background Emerging evidence highlights the critical role of amino acid metabolism in the pathogenesis and severity of COVID-19. This review included studies encompassing patients with varying degrees of disease severity, from mild to critical cases. Methods A systematic review following PRISMA guidelines was conducted, and study quality was appraised using the Newcastle–Ottawa tools to explore the relationship between amino acid profiles and clinical outcomes in COVID-19 patients. A comprehensive search of PubMed, Scopus, Web of Science, and Google Scholar (from the start of the pandemic through the most recent data available on December 2024) identified peer-reviewed studies reporting original data on amino acid metabolism in COVID-19 patients. Results Fourteen eligiblestudies involving 1355 confirmed COVID-19 patients (1726 total participants) were included and revealed significant disruptions inamino acid profiles. Key findings included reduced levels of arginine, glutamine, and tryptophan, alongside elevated phenylalanine andbranched-chain amino acids (BCAAs). These changes were associated with disease severity, immune suppression, systemicinflammation, and metabolic reprogramming. Dysregulation of pathways such as the urea cycle and kynurenine pathway were linked toendothelial dysfunction and immune dysregulation. Conclusions Dysregulated amino acid profiles may serve as potential biomarkers for disease severity and require further validation before clinical application. Restoring amino acid balance or modulating metabolic pathways could improve clinical outcomes. Further research is needed to validate these findings and explore personalized treatment strategies aimed at mitigating the metabolic consequences of SARS-CoV-2 infection.

papers.title_zh: SARS-CoV-2 引起的 COVID-19 患者氨基酸谱的系统评价
papers.source_body_en: Abstract Background Emerging evidence highlights the critical role of amino acid metabolism in the pathogenesis and severity of COVID-19. This review included studies encompassing patients with varying degrees of disease severity, from mild to critical cases. Methods A systematic review following PRISMA guidelines was conducted, and study quality was appraised using the Newcastle–Ottawa tools to explore the relationship between amino acid profiles and clinical outcomes in COVID-19 patients. A comprehensive search of PubMed, Scopus, Web of Science, and Google Scholar (from the start of the pandemic through the most recent data available on December 2024) identified peer-reviewed studies reporting original data on amino acid metabolism in COVID-19 patients. Results Fourteen eligiblestudies involving 1355 confirmed COVID-19 patients (1726 total participants) were included and revealed significant disruptions inamino acid profiles. Key findings included reduced levels of arginine, glutamine, and tryptophan, alongside elevated phenylalanine andbranched-chain amino acids (BCAAs). These changes were associated with disease severity, immune suppression, systemicinflammation, and metabolic reprogramming. Dysregulation of pathways such as the urea cycle and kynurenine pathway were linked toendothelial dysfunction and immune dysregulation. Conclusions Dysregulated amino acid profiles may serve as potential biomarkers for disease severity and require further validation before clinical application. Restoring amino acid balance or modulating metabolic pathways could improve clinical outcomes. Further research is needed to validate these findings and explore personalized treatment strategies aimed at mitigating the metabolic consequences of SARS-CoV-2 infection.
papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 背景 新出现的证据强调了氨基酸代谢在 COVID-19 发病机制和严重程度中的关键作用。该综述纳入的研究涵盖了疾病严重程度从轻度到危重的不同程度的患者。方法 按照 PRISMA 指南进行系统评价,并使用纽卡斯尔-渥太华工具评估研究质量,以探讨氨基酸谱与 COVID-19 患者临床结果之间的关系。对 PubMed、Scopus、Web of Science 和 Google Scholar 的全面搜索(从大流行开始到 2024 年 12 月的最新数据)发现了报告 COVID-19 患者氨基酸代谢原始数据的同行评审研究。结果 纳入了 14 项符合条件的研究,涉及 1355 名确诊的 COVID-19 患者(总共 1726 名参与者),结果显示氨基酸谱存在显着破坏。主要发现包括精氨酸、谷氨酰胺和色氨酸水平降低,同时苯丙氨酸和支链氨基酸 (BCAA) 水平升高。这些变化与疾病严重程度、免疫抑制、全身炎症和代谢重编程有关。尿素循环和犬尿氨酸途径等途径的失调与内皮功能障碍和免疫失调有关。结论 失调的氨基酸谱可能作为疾病严重程度的潜在生物标志物,在临床应用前需要进一步验证。恢复氨基酸平衡或调节代谢途径可以改善临床结果。需要进一步的研究来验证这些发现,并探索旨在减轻 SARS-CoV-2 感染的代谢后果的个性化治疗策略。

papers.title: Neutralisation capacity against SARS-CoV-2 ancestral, Delta and Omicron variants before and after heterologous booster vaccination in Fijian health system workers
papers.abstract: Abstract Immunogenicity studies of booster doses of COVID-19 vaccines from Pacific Island countries are limited. A prospective cohort study was conducted amongst healthcare workers in Fiji to assess antibody neutralisation capacity against ancestral, Delta and Omicron (BA.2) variants following high force of infection from Delta during administration of primary dose schedules. Findings showed high baseline neutralisation prior to heterologous booster vaccinations and enduring protective neutralisation against all three variants of SARS-CoV2 at 6 months following booster receipt. Limited benefit from third doses in this population emphasises the need for pragmatic vaccination strategies guided by local disease contexts.

papers.title: Microvascular Thrombosis and Acute Kidney Injury in COVID-19: A Systematic Review and Quantitative Analysis
papers.abstract: Abstract Objective: To synthesize the available evidence on the association between SARS-CoV-2-related microvascular thrombosis and acute kidney injury (AKI), with emphasis on renal outcomes, mortality, and renal replacement therapy requirements. Methods: This systematic review followed the PRISMA 2020 statement and was prospectively registered in PROSPERO (CRD420251132701). PubMed/MEDLINE, Scopus, and Embase were searched for systematic reviews, including meta-analyses, and umbrella reviews investigating the association between SARS-CoV-2-related microvascular thrombosis and acute kidney injury. Two reviewers independently performed study selection, data extraction, and methodological quality assessment using AMSTAR-2 and ROBIS. Evidence was synthesized through a structured narrative synthesis supported by quantitative data extracted from the included reviews. Results: Six evidence syntheses evaluating kidney involvement, thrombotic events, and microvascular mechanisms in COVID-19 were included. AKI incidence was 9.2% (95%CI 4.6-13.9) among hospitalized patients and 32.6% (95%CI 8.5-56.6) among critically ill patients. In children with multisystem inflammatory syndrome associated with SARS-CoV-2, AKI incidence was 20% (95%CI 14-28). Microvascular or thrombotic events were associated with adverse renal outcomes (OR 2.14; 95%CI 1.32-3.48). AKI was associated with increased mortality (OR 4.68; 95%CI 1.06-20.70) and greater likelihood of renal replacement therapy requirement (OR 2.87; 95%CI 1.45-5.68). The certainty of evidence ranged from moderate to high for the principal outcomes. Conclusion: Current evidence supports an important association between microvascular thrombotic injury and COVID-19-associated AKI. These findings reinforce the relevance of endothelial dysfunction and thromboinflammatory pathways in kidney involvement during COVID-19 and highlight the need for early renal monitoring, risk stratification, and kidney-protective strategies in high-risk patients. Keywords: COVID-19; Acute Kidney Injury; Microvascular Thrombosis; SARS-CoV-2; Renal Replacement Therapy; Systematic Review

papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 目的:综合 SARS-CoV-2 相关微血管血栓形成与急性肾损伤 (AKI) 之间关联的现有证据,重点关注肾脏结局、死亡率和肾脏替代治疗需求。方法:本系统评价遵循 PRISMA 2020 声明,并前瞻性地在 PROSPERO 中注册(CRD420251132701)。检索了 PubMed/MEDLINE、Scopus 和 Embase 的系统综述,包括荟萃分析和伞式综述,调查 SARS-CoV-2 相关微血管血栓形成与急性肾损伤之间的关联。两名评审员使用 AMSTAR-2 和 ROBIS 独立进行研究选择、数据提取和方法学质量评估。通过结构化叙述综合来综合证据,并辅以从纳入的评论中提取的定量数据。结果:纳入了评估 COVID-19 肾脏受累、血栓事件和微血管机制的六项证据综合。住院患者中 AKI 发生率为 9.2%(95%CI 4.6-13.9),危重患者中 AKI 发生率为 32.6%(95%CI 8.5-56.6)。在患有与 SARS-CoV-2 相关的多系统炎症综合征的儿童中,AKI 发生率为 20% (95%CI 14-28)。微血管或血栓事件与不良肾脏结局相关(OR 2.14;95%CI 1.32-3.48)。AKI 与死亡率增加(OR 4.68;95%CI 1.06-20.70)以及需要肾脏替代治疗的可能性更大(OR 2.87;95%CI 1.45-5.68)相关。主要结果的证据质量从中到高不等。结论:当前证据支持微血管血栓性损伤与 COVID-19 相关 AKI 之间存在重要关联。这些发现强化了内皮功能障碍和血栓炎症途径与 COVID-19 期间肾脏受累的相关性,并强调了对高危患者进行早期肾脏监测、风险分层和肾脏保护策略的必要性。关键词:COVID-19;急性肾损伤;微血管血栓形成;SARS-CoV-2;肾脏替代治疗;系统审查

papers.title: The indirect oncological burden of the COVID-19 pandemic: global disruptions in lung cancer diagnosis, surgical management, and healthcare system resilience — a narrative review
papers.abstract: Abstract Background The coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19) pandemic imposed substantial challenges on healthcare systems worldwide, significantly influencing the diagnosis, treatment processes, and clinical outcomes of patients with lung cancer. This article aims to evaluate the indirect oncological consequences of the pandemic, with particular emphasis on delays in diagnosis, staging, and surgical treatment from a thoracic surgery perspective. Methods During the pandemic, extensive structural and administrative transformations were implemented in hospitals, including reorganization of clinical services, allocation of dedicated COVID-19 units, postponement of elective procedures, and redistribution of healthcare resources. While these measures were essential for infection control, they significantly limited access to routine oncological care. This study was designed as a narrative review. Literature was searched in PubMed databases for studies published between January 2020 and February 2026 using combinations of the terms “COVID-19”, “lung cancer”, “thoracic surgery”, “delay diagnosis”. English-language articles evaluating the impact of the pandemic on lung cancer diagnosis, staging, treatment, and outcomes were included. Relevant studies were selected based on clinical relevance and methodological quality. Case reports were excluded from the study as exclusion criteria. Results Evidence from multiple international studies demonstrates substantial reductions in lung cancer diagnoses, decreased surgical volumes, prolonged referral and treatment intervals, and a shift toward more advanced disease stages at presentation. Screening interruptions, patient reluctance to seek medical attention, and restricted diagnostic procedures contributed to a global “diagnostic deficit.” Although surgical outcomes remained generally safe when appropriate protective protocols were applied, treatment delays and altered therapeutic strategies, including increased use of radiotherapy and systemic therapies, raised concerns regarding long-term oncological outcomes. Overall, the pandemic highlighted the vulnerability of cancer care systems during global health crises while also demonstrating that continuity of thoracic oncology services can be maintained through structured protocols and dedicated pathways. Conclusion These findings underscore the necessity of developing resilient healthcare systems capable of preserving timely cancer diagnosis and treatment during future pandemics to minimize indirect mortality and loss of life-years among lung cancer patients.

papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 背景 2019 年冠状病毒病(COVID-19)大流行给全球医疗保健系统带来了巨大挑战,显着影响了肺癌患者的诊断、治疗过程和临床结果。本文旨在评估大流行的间接肿瘤学后果,特别强调从胸外科角度诊断、分期和手术治疗的延误。方法 在大流行期间,医院实施了广泛的结构和行政改革,包括重组临床服务、分配专门的 COVID-19 病房、推迟择期手术以及重新分配医疗资源。虽然这些措施对于控制感染至关重要,但它们极大地限制了获得常规肿瘤护理的机会。本研究旨在作为叙述性回顾。在 PubMed 数据库中检索了 2020 年 1 月至 2026 年 2 月期间发表的研究文献,其中使用了术语“COVID-19”、“肺癌”、“胸外科”、“延迟诊断”的组合。其中包括评估大流行对肺癌诊断、分期、治疗和结果影响的英文文章。根据临床相关性和方法学质量选择相关研究。作为排除标准,病例报告被排除在研究之外。结果 来自多项国际研究的证据表明,肺癌诊断数量大幅减少、手术量减少、转诊和治疗间隔延长以及就诊时疾病阶段向更晚期的转变。筛查中断、患者不愿就医以及诊断程序受限导致了全球“诊断缺陷”。尽管在应用适当的保护方案时,手术结果总体上仍然是安全的,但治疗延迟和治疗策略的改变,包括增加放射治疗和全身治疗的使用,引起了人们对长期肿瘤结果的担忧。总体而言,这场大流行凸显了全球健康危机期间癌症护理系统的脆弱性,同时也表明可以通过结构化方案和专用途径维持胸部肿瘤服务的连续性。结论 这些发现强调了开发有弹性的医疗保健系统的必要性,该系统能够在未来的大流行期间保持及时的癌症诊断和治疗,以最大限度地减少肺癌患者的间接死亡率和生命年损失。

papers.title: Genomic and Antigenic Evolution of Influenza A(H3N2) After the COVID-19 Era: A Scoping Review with Focus on J and K Subclades and Implications for Vaccine Effectiveness
papers.abstract: Post-COVID-19, influenza A(H3N2) has re-emerged with accelerated genetic diversification. The rise in antigenically drifted subclades raises concerns regarding immune escape and vaccine mismatch. To synthesize the available evidence on the post-pandemic evolution of influenza A(H3N2), with particular attention to emerging subclades and their potential public health implications, a scoping review (PRISMA-ScR) was conducted across six databases in January 2026, including studies on genomic surveillance, antigenic characterization, and vaccine effectiveness (VE). papers.title: Complex intra-host SARS-CoV-2 evolution following monoclonal antibody pre-exposure prophylaxis
papers.abstract: BackgroundMonoclonal antibodies have emerged as a prophylactic strategy to prevent symptomatic SARS-CoV-2 infection in immunocompromised individuals. However, the evolutionary and clinical implications of breakthrough infections under this regime remain unclear. MethodsA male in their 80s with a haematological/oncological diagnosis received a 2000 mg intravenous infusion of sotrovimab in March 2023 and was diagnosed with COVID-19 by RT-qPCR from a nasopharyngeal swab in August 2023. Weekly samples (n=24) were collected through February 2024 (171 days). All samples underwent whole-genome sequencing, with select mutations subjected to functional assessment. FindingsSequencing identified the GE.1 lineage at all timepoints. An intra-host recombination event in ORF1ab (positions 8942-12458) was detected prior to 23 weeks post-detection, followed by a 14-fold increase in viral load (7.42e+06 to 1.00e+08 RNA copies/mL) and a marked shift in the viral population. E340D, a sotrovimab resistance mutation, was detected at low abundance (46%) within the first week post-infection, fluctuated over time, and was nearly fixed by week 15 (107 days) post-detection. We assessed five spike mutations - V36M, S98F, and V213G in the N-terminal domain, Y505P in the receptor-binding domain, and P681Q near the S1/S2 cleavage site- and additionally evaluated the impact of E340D. V36M conferred the highest infectivity across all cell lines, with the most significant effect in low-TMPRSS2 cells. While all mutations showed enhanced infectivity with the addition of E340D, the effect was most pronounced in mutations with lower baseline infectivity. The addition of E340D significantly decreased relative neutralizing titres for V36M, S98F, and V213G, enabling escape from neutralizing antibodies in XBB-responsive individuals, illustrating an enhanced phenotypic advantage. Patient neutralizing activity was absent pre-sotrovimab, and sotrovimab-induced neutralization was further compromised by selection of E340D. InterpretationSotrovimab pre-exposure prophylaxis in an immunocompromised patient did not prevent SARS-CoV-2 infection, and selected for resistant mutation E340D, with unexpected fitness consequences across non-receptor binding domain spike regions. analysis.summary_en: This study reports a case of complex intra-host SARS-CoV-2 evolution in an immunocompromised patient receiving sotrovimab pre-exposure prophylaxis. The patient developed a breakthrough infection, and whole-genome sequencing revealed the GE.1 lineage at all timepoints. A recombination event in ORF1ab occurred prior to 23 weeks post-detection, followed by a 14-fold increase in viral load and a marked shift in the viral population. The sotrovimab resistance mutation E340D was selected, initially at low abundance (46%) and nearly fixed by week 15. Functional assessment showed that E340D conferred enhanced infectivity, particularly in mutations with lower baseline infectivity, and significantly decreased neutralizing titres, enabling escape from antibodies in XBB-responsive individuals. The findings suggest that monoclonal antibody prophylaxis can drive viral evolution and reduce antibody efficacy.

papers.title_zh: 单克隆抗体暴露前预防后宿主内 SARS-CoV-2 的复杂进化
papers.source_body_en: BackgroundMonoclonal antibodies have emerged as a prophylactic strategy to prevent symptomatic SARS-CoV-2 infection in immunocompromised individuals. However, the evolutionary and clinical implications of breakthrough infections under this regime remain unclear. MethodsA male in their 80s with a haematological/oncological diagnosis received a 2000 mg intravenous infusion of sotrovimab in March 2023 and was diagnosed with COVID-19 by RT-qPCR from a nasopharyngeal swab in August 2023. Weekly samples (n=24) were collected through February 2024 (171 days). All samples underwent whole-genome sequencing, with select mutations subjected to functional assessment. FindingsSequencing identified the GE.1 lineage at all timepoints. An intra-host recombination event in ORF1ab (positions 8942-12458) was detected prior to 23 weeks post-detection, followed by a 14-fold increase in viral load (7.42e+06 to 1.00e+08 RNA copies/mL) and a marked shift in the viral population. We assessed five spike mutations - V36M, S98F, and V213G in the N-terminal domain, Y505P in the receptor-binding domain, and P681Q near the S1/S2 cleavage site- and additionally evaluated the impact of E340D. V36M conferred the highest infectivity across all cell lines, with the most significant effect in low-TMPRSS2 cells. While all mutations showed enhanced infectivity with the addition of E340D, the effect was most pronounced in mutations with lower baseline infectivity. The addition of E340D significantly decreased relative neutralizing titres for V36M, S98F, and V213G, enabling escape from neutralizing antibodies in XBB-responsive individuals, illustrating an enhanced phenotypic advantage. Patient neutralizing activity was absent pre-sotrovimab, and sotrovimab-induced neutralization was further compromised by selection of E340D. InterpretationSotrovimab pre-exposure prophylaxis in an immunocompromised patient did not prevent SARS-CoV-2 infection, and selected for resistant mutation E340D, with unexpected fitness consequences across non-receptor binding domain spike regions. papers.title: Systemic immune profiling of heterologous versus homologous boosting of COVID-19 vaccination
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Compared with homologous boosting, heterologous boosting with a different COVID-19 vaccine following priming generates stronger antibody responses against severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2 (SARS-CoV-2) as well as variants, particularly for inactivated COVID-19 vaccine(CoronaVac). However, it is still unclear about the potential immune enhancement mechanism underlying heterologous boosting. METHODS: In this study, we isolated spike protein binding-specific monoclonal antibodies at day 180 post a homologous booster with CoronaVac or a heterologous booster with Ad5-nCoV based on two-dose of CoronaVac using the single B cell sorting platform. Subsequently, we verified their neutralization activity to SARS-CoV-2 variants, germline gene sequences and affinity kinetics targeting SARS-CoV-2 NTD/RBD/S1. Additionally, we conducted an in-depth analysis of the immunological response characteristics, by integrating single-cell RNA/V(D)J sequencing(scRNA/ V(D)J-seq). RESULTS: Our study demonstrated that heterologous boosting with Ad5-nCoV elicited more mature B cells with higher affinity and activated more abundant immune-related pathways compared to the homologous boosting with CoronaVac. In addition, Ad5-nCoV boosting expanded unique clonal types of B and T cells, whereas CoronaVac boosting led to a small-sized clonal expansion. Furthermore, the utilization of germlines associated with neutralizing antibody were preferentially enriched in recipients with Ad5-nCoV boosting. CONCLUSIONS: Above all, our study gives insights for elaborating the systemic immune landscape of heterologous-boosting COVID-19 immunization by the novel single B cell sorting platform and scRNA/V(D)J-seq technology. TRIAL REGISTRATION NUMBER: NCT04892459.

analysis.methods: The researchers integrated single-cell RNA/V(D)J sequencing (scRNA/V(D)J-seq) to conduct an in-depth analysis of the immunological response characteristics, including germline gene sequences and pathways.

papers.abstract_zh: 背景:与同源加强相比,初免后使用不同的 COVID-19 疫苗进行异源加强可产生更强的针对严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒 2 (SARS-CoV-2) 及其变体的抗体反应,特别是对于灭活的 COVID-19 疫苗 (CoronaVac)。然而,目前尚不清楚异源增强潜在的免疫增强机制。方法:在本研究中,我们使用单 B 细胞分选平台,在使用 CoronaVac 进行同源加强接种或使用基于两剂 CoronaVac 的异源加强接种 Ad5-nCoV 后第 180 天分离出刺突蛋白结合特异性单克隆抗体。随后,我们验证了它们对 SARS-CoV-2 变体的中和活性、种系基因序列以及针对 SARS-CoV-2 NTD/RBD/S1 的亲和动力学。此外,我们通过整合单细胞RNA/V(D)J测序(scRNA/V(D)J-seq)对免疫反应特征进行了深入分析。结果:我们的研究表明,与 CoronaVac 的同源加强相比,Ad5-nCoV 的异源加强能引发更多具有更高亲和力的成熟 B 细胞,并激活更丰富的免疫相关途径。此外,Ad5-nCoV 加强版扩增了 B 细胞和 T 细胞的独特克隆类型,而 CoronaVac 加强版则导致了小规模的克隆扩增。此外,与中和抗体相关的种系的利用在 Ad5-nCoV 加强的受体中优先富集。结论:最重要的是,我们的研究为通过新型单 B 细胞分选平台和 scRNA/V(D)J-seq 技术阐述异源增强 COVID-19 免疫的系统免疫景观提供了见解。试用注册号:NCT04892459。

papers.title: Malaria burden and care in hard-to-reach indigenous communities in the Peruvian Amazon during the COVID-19 pandemic: A mixed-methods study
papers.abstract: Background The COVID-19 pandemic was associated with reported disruptions to healthcare delivery and malaria control activities in remote, malaria-endemic indigenous communities with limited access to healthcare. Remote indigenous communities in the Peruvian Amazon may have been especially vulnerable due to interruptions in malaria surveillance, diagnosis, and treatment. We investigated the impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on malaria burden, healthcare access, and community perceptions in hard-to-reach indigenous communities in the Amazonas region of Peru. In malaria-endemic regions, these lessons are particularly important because future health emergencies may similarly affect surveillance, diagnosis, prevention, and treatment activities, potentially reversing gains achieved through malaria control programs. Methods A convergent parallel mixed-methods study was conducted in 2021 and 2022 across four indigenous communities in the Río Santiago district, Amazonas region, Peru. Quantitative data were collected through cross-sectional malaria surveys, and qualitative data were obtained through semi- structured interviews with inhabitants, community health workers, and local health personnel. Malaria infections were detected by microscopy and confirmed by PCR. Factors associated with the occurrence of malaria infection were studied based on a generalized estimating equation (GEE) approach applied to clustered binary outcome data and accounting for repeated observations within participants across study years. Qualitative data were analyzed thematically, and both components were integrated using the Pillar Integration Process framework. Results A total of 514 participants were included. PCR-based malaria prevalence was 17.6% in 2021 and 26.09% in 2022. falciparum prevalence was particularly high in the Alianza Progreso community (2021: 24.19%, 2022: 16.16%) compared to the other studied communities. Previous malaria infection and chills were associated with PCR-confirmed malaria infection. Qualitative findings indicated that COVID-19-related disruptions affected malaria control activities by interrupting diagnosis and treatment availability, reducing community follow-up, and prioritizing COVID-19 response activities over malaria control. Participants also described fear of COVID-19, temporary migration to farm areas, and reliance on herbal medicine during the pandemic. Conclusions The COVID-19 pandemic may have contributed to exacerbated pre-existing challenges to malaria control in remote indigenous communities in the Peruvian Amazon. Strengthening malaria surveillance, ensuring continuity of diagnosis and treatment, and improving healthcare access in geographically isolated communities will be critical to supporting malaria elimination efforts in Peru. Author summary The COVID-19 pandemic disrupted essential health services worldwide, with potentially greater consequences for remote malaria-endemic communities with limited healthcare access. Indigenous populations in the Peruvian Amazon faced additional challenges due to interruptions in malaria surveillance, diagnosis, treatment, and control activities. We assessed the impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on malaria burden and healthcare access in four remote indigenous communities in the Amazonas region of Peru by combining malaria screening with interviews involving community members, community health workers, and healthcare personnel. Our findings showed persistent malaria transmission during the pandemic period, particularly in communities affected by Plasmodium falciparum . papers.abstract_zh: 背景 据报道,在疟疾流行的偏远土著社区,获得医疗服务的机会有限,因此 COVID-19 大流行与医疗服务提供和疟疾控制活动中断有关。由于疟疾监测、诊断和治疗的中断,秘鲁亚马逊地区的偏远土著社区可能特别容易受到影响。我们调查了 COVID-19 大流行对秘鲁亚马逊地区难以到达的土著社区的疟疾负担、医疗保健获取和社区认知的影响。在疟疾流行地区,这些教训尤其重要,因为未来的突发卫生事件可能同样影响监测、诊断、预防和治疗活动,有可能逆转通过疟疾控制计划取得的成果。方法 2021 年和 2022 年在秘鲁亚马逊地区里奥圣地亚哥区的四个土著社区进行了一项收敛并行混合方法研究。定量数据通过横断面疟疾调查收集,定性数据通过对居民、社区卫生工作者和当地卫生人员的半结构化访谈获得。通过显微镜检测疟疾感染并通过PCR确认。基于广义估计方程(GEE)方法研究了与疟疾感染发生相关的因素,该方法应用于聚类二元结果数据,并考虑了研究年份中参与者的重复观察结果。对定性数据进行了主题分析,并使用支柱集成流程框架集成了这两个组件。结果 共有 514 名参与者被纳入。基于 PCR 的疟疾患病率在 2021 年为 17.6%,在 2022 年为 26.09%。与其他研究社区相比,Alianza Progreso 社区的恶性疟疾患病率特别高(2021 年:24.19%,2022 年:16.16%)。既往疟疾感染和发冷与 PCR 确诊的疟疾感染有关。定性研究结果表明,与 COVID-19 相关的干扰影响了疟疾控制活动,因为中断了诊断和治疗的可用性、减少了社区随访以及将 COVID-19 应对活动置于疟疾控制之上。参与者还描述了对 COVID-19 的恐惧、暂时迁移到农场地区以及在大流行期间对草药的依赖。结论 COVID-19 大流行可能加剧了秘鲁亚马逊偏远土著社区疟疾控制方面先前存在的挑战。加强疟疾监测、确保诊断和治疗的连续性以及改善地理偏远社区的医疗保健服务对于支持秘鲁消除疟疾工作至关重要。作者摘要 COVID-19 大流行扰乱了全世界的基本卫生服务,可能对医疗服务有限的偏远疟疾流行社区造成更大的影响。由于疟疾监测、诊断、治疗和控制活动的中断,秘鲁亚马逊地区的土著居民面临着额外的挑战。我们通过将疟疾筛查与对社区成员、社区卫生工作者和医护人员的访谈相结合,评估了 COVID-19 大流行对秘鲁亚马逊地区四个偏远土著社区的疟疾负担和医疗保健获取的影响。我们的研究结果表明,疟疾在大流行期间持续传播,特别是在受恶性疟原虫影响的社区。参与者报告说,获得疟疾诊断和治疗的机会减少,社区后续活动减少,害怕去医疗机构就诊,以及就医行为发生变化。这些发现凸显了突发卫生事件如何加剧地理偏远人群中的现有障碍,并威胁消除疟疾的努力。加强有复原力的卫生系统并确保未来危机期间基本疟疾服务的连续性对于保护亚马逊地区的脆弱社区至关重要。

papers.title: Generation and immunological evaluation of SARS-CoV-2 membrane protein virus-like particles
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: The emergence of the SARS-CoV-2 pandemic led to the spread of highly transmissible variants, such as the Delta variant, which originated in India, underscoring the urgent need to develop new antivirals, therapeutics, and vaccines. In our previous study, we showed that Membrane-Envelope Virus-like Particles exhibit antigenicity and neutralization activity. Hence, our present study was conducted to evaluate whether the M protein alone can form VLPs that elicit an immune response. METHODS: Using computational methods, we identified key interacting residues in M-protein that contribute to VLP formation and interact with other structural proteins, including Spike (S), Nucleocapsid (N), and Envelope (E). The SARS-CoV-2-M protein was expressed in Sf-21 insect cells, and the resulting VLPs were purified, analyzed for shape and size, and characterized using DLS, FESEM, and TEM. The purified VLPs were injected into BALB/c mice to evaluate their immune response compared with uninfected controls. RESULTS: The biophysical analysis confirms that the particles are round and have a size of ~ 180-200 nm. The serum levels of IgG, IgM, and IgA were found to be higher in immunized mice than in uninfected mice. Further qRT-PCR analysis demonstrated the levels of IFN-γ, IL-2, and IL-12, indicating a TH1-biased immune response against the M protein. CONCLUSION: Our study demonstrates that the highly conserved M protein can self-assemble into VLPs and elicit humoral and cellular immune response. Furthermore, our study indicates that while M-protein VLPs elicit significant antibodies and cytokine responses, they do not induce detectable neutralizing activity when given alone.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates the potential of the SARS-CoV-2 membrane (M) protein to form virus-like particles (VLPs) and elicit an immune response. Using computational methods, the researchers identified key residues in the M protein that contribute to VLP formation. The M protein was expressed in Sf-21 insect cells, and the resulting VLPs were purified and characterized for size and shape. The VLPs were injected into BALB/c mice, and the immune response was evaluated. The results showed that the VLPs were round and had a size of ~180-200 nm. Immunized mice exhibited higher levels of IgG, IgM, and IgA compared to uninfected controls, indicating a humoral response. Additionally, a TH1-biased cellular response was observed, with elevated levels of IFN-γ, IL-2, and IL-12. The study concludes that the M protein can self-assemble into VLPs and elicit both humoral and cellular immune responses, although it does not induce detectable neutralizing activity when given alone. This suggests that the M protein could be a candidate for inclusion in multi-epitope vaccines.

papers.title: Skin manifestations of primary COVID-19 infection with the omicron variant
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Although cutaneous manifestations of COVID-19 have been increasingly documented across earlier variants, the dermatological characteristics specifically associated with the Omicron variant, particularly in the Chinese population, remain insufficiently characterized in the literature. OBJECTIVE: To characterize cutaneous manifestations in patients with primary COVID-19 infection caused by the Omicron variant and corresponding management. METHODS: 94 participants were included in this retrospective analysis, who developed dermatologic symptoms within one month of COVID-19 Omicron Variant infection. RESULTS: Mean age was 38 years old, ranging from 7 to 89; with 66% aged within 25-50. A significantly higher incidence of skin manifestations was reported among females (males vs. females, 1:2.76, p = 0.001). Skin rashes typically appeared three days after the onset of COVID symptoms (ranging between 2-7 days), which were mostly mild to moderate. Common morphological types included wheals, erythema, and papular/papulovesicular eruptions. Generalized rashes occurred in 50% of cases, while localized rashes mainly affected the extremities. Pruritus was the most frequent symptom (>90%), particularly in patients presenting with wheals. Clinical management included topical steroid creams and antiviral treatment for COVID-19. No follow-ups were required for most participants (>95%). CONCLUSION: Skin rashes associated with Omicron variant COVID-19 infection, predominantly affecting young and middle-aged women, are characterized by wheals, erythema, and papular/papulovesicular eruptions. Early identification and management of these cutaneous symptoms should be integrated in the overall treatment plan of Omicron variant COVID-19 infection.

papers.abstract_zh: 背景:尽管越来越多的早期变种记录了 COVID-19 的皮肤表现,但与 Omicron 变种特别相关的皮肤病学特征,特别是在中国人群中,在文献中仍然没有充分描述。目的:描述由 Omicron 变种引起的原发性 COVID-19 感染患者的皮肤表现及相应的治疗。方法:本次回顾性分析纳入了 94 名参与者,他们在感染 COVID-19 Omicron 变体后 1 个月内出现皮肤症状。结果:平均年龄为 38 岁,范围为 7 岁至 89 岁;其中66%的人年龄在25-50岁之间。据报道,女性皮肤症状的发生率明显较高(男性与女性,1:2.76,p = 0.001)。皮疹通常在新冠肺炎症状出现三天后(2-7 天)出现,大多为轻度至中度。常见的形态类型包括风团、红斑和丘疹/丘疱疹。50%的病例出现全身皮疹,而局部皮疹主要影响四肢。瘙痒是最常见的症状(>90%),尤其是出现风团的患者。临床管理包括局部类固醇乳膏和针对 COVID-19 的抗病毒治疗。大多数参与者(>95%)不需要后续行动。结论:与 Omicron 变异型 COVID-19 感染相关的皮疹主要影响年轻和中年女性,其特点是风团、红斑和丘疹/丘疹水疱疹。应将这些皮肤症状的早期识别和管理纳入 Omicron 变异 COVID-19 感染的整体治疗计划中。

papers.title: PI3K gene variants are associated with elevated IL-6 levels and COVID-19 severe outcomes in a multicenter study
papers.abstract: The COVID-19 caused by SARS-CoV-2 has resulted in widely variable clinical outcomes. The virus relies on host metabolic pathways particularly the PI3K/AKT/mTOR axis, which regulate cell survival, metabolism, and viral replication. Genetic variants whitin this pathway may influence disease severity. This study evaluated variants in PI3K genes among 216 mild and 291 severe COVID-19 patients, focusing on rs3730089 (PIK3R1), rs785468 (PIK3R3), and rs11121484 (PIK3CD). Genotypes were evaluted in peripheral blood samples, inflammatory cytokines (IL-6 and TNF) were measured in plasma samples and immune cell profiles were assessed in peripheral blood mononuclear cells. The C allele of rs11121484 was associated with susceptibility to severe COVID-19, while rs785468 and rs3730089 were correlated with higher mortality risk. The presence of multiple risk alleles showed a cumulative effect on disease outcome. Patients with the GG genotype of rs3730089 had increased IL-6 levels, and carriers of risk alleles displayed reduced non-classic monocytes and CD4 + memory T cells. These findings indicate that PI3K single-nucleotide variants (SNVs) may exacerbate inflammation and immune dysregulation in COVID-19, contributing to severe outcomes. Overall, these results highlight a potential pathological role for PI3K SNVs in driving hyperinflammation in COVID-19 patients and may contributes to predicting the severe outcome of COVID-19 and better disease prognosis.

papers.title_zh: 一项多中心研究显示 PI3K 基因变异与 IL-6 水平升高和 COVID-19 严重后果相关
papers.source_body_en: The COVID-19 caused by SARS-CoV-2 has resulted in widely variable clinical outcomes. The virus relies on host metabolic pathways particularly the PI3K/AKT/mTOR axis, which regulate cell survival, metabolism, and viral replication. Genetic variants whitin this pathway may influence disease severity. This study evaluated variants in PI3K genes among 216 mild and 291 severe COVID-19 patients, focusing on rs3730089 (PIK3R1), rs785468 (PIK3R3), and rs11121484 (PIK3CD). Genotypes were evaluted in peripheral blood samples, inflammatory cytokines (IL-6 and TNF) were measured in plasma samples and immune cell profiles were assessed in peripheral blood mononuclear cells. The C allele of rs11121484 was associated with susceptibility to severe COVID-19, while rs785468 and rs3730089 were correlated with higher mortality risk. The presence of multiple risk alleles showed a cumulative effect on disease outcome. Patients with the GG genotype of rs3730089 had increased IL-6 levels, and carriers of risk alleles displayed reduced non-classic monocytes and CD4 + memory T cells. These findings indicate that PI3K single-nucleotide variants (SNVs) may exacerbate inflammation and immune dysregulation in COVID-19, contributing to severe outcomes. Overall, these results highlight a potential pathological role for PI3K SNVs in driving hyperinflammation in COVID-19 patients and may contributes to predicting the severe outcome of COVID-19 and better disease prognosis.
papers.abstract_zh: 由 SARS-CoV-2 引起的 COVID-19 导致临床结果差异很大。该病毒依赖宿主代谢途径,特别是 PI3K/AKT/mTOR 轴,调节细胞存活、代谢和病毒复制。该途径中的遗传变异可能会影响疾病的严重程度。本研究评估了 216 名轻度和 291 名重症 COVID-19 患者的 PI3K 基因变异,重点关注 rs3730089 (PIK3R1)、rs785468 (PIK3R3) 和 rs11121484 (PIK3CD)。评估外周血样本中的基因型,测量血浆样本中的炎性细胞因子(IL-6和TNF),并评估外周血单核细胞中的免疫细胞谱。rs11121484 的 C 等位基因与严重 COVID-19 的易感性相关,而 rs785468 和 rs3730089 与较高的死亡风险相关。多个风险等位基因的存在显示出对疾病结果的累积影响。rs3730089 GG 基因型患者的 IL-6 水平升高,风险等位基因携带者的非经典单核细胞和 CD4 + 记忆 T 细胞减少。这些发现表明 PI3K 单核苷酸变异 (SNV) 可能会加剧 COVID-19 中的炎症和免疫失调,从而导致严重的后果。总体而言,这些结果强调了 PI3K SNV 在驱动 COVID-19 患者过度炎症中的潜在病理作用,并可能有助于预测 COVID-19 的严重后果和更好的疾病预后。
